environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 instances in a VPC with an S3 VPC endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) configured with a FULL ACCESS policy (Allow * on *). The EC2 instance role has s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject permissions on 'arn:aws:s3:::*'. The application is exposed via an ALB with no request filtering. STAGING_BUCKET is set to 'company-docs-staging' but the bucket parameter is user-controllable.

config.alb_rules: default forward to target group, no WAF attached
